reason: CP1 establishes the EU/EEA regulatory scope and mentions regulations and directives, setting the foundation for CP2 which defines these legal instruments in detail.
CP2 explains the difference between regulations and directives, which is essential background for understanding the history of AMLDs (directives) in CP3.
CP3 covers the history of AMLDs up to 5AMLD, providing the context for CP4 which discusses further harmonization efforts and the Single Rulebook (including 6AMLD).
